text:
Today I had a cough and runny nose, but didn't see a doctor, only an employee. They gave me one injection, 20 cough syrup pills, 20 antibiotics, and 20 fever reducers for 1,200 baht. They said the injection was 500 baht, the medicine 600 baht, and the doctor's fee 100 baht. Unbelievable!
If you're going to charge like this, you should ask the customer if they want treatment for this amount, instead of forcing their hand. What if I don't have much money?
author_name: เฮง เฮง รวย รวย

text:
I'm Japanese.
I used this service for a PCR test to obtain proof of a negative result for returning home.

They were able to accommodate me even though I showed up without an appointment.

It can be difficult to find a car for the return trip (by taxi or Grab), so it might be a good idea to ask your driver to wait for you. The test itself was completed in about 15 minutes from the time of check-in.

I received the test results via email. I received the English version first, and then the Japanese version was sent to me a while later.
